title: Energy exchange between Nd3+ and Er3+ centers within molecular complexes

material_class.structural_family: quasi-linear [LnLn'Ln] heterometallic complex with LA2- and LB2-

synthesis.procedure: The SI states that [Lu2Nd(LA)2(LB)2(py)(H2O)2](NO3) (1) was prepared according to a previously published procedure; this article does not repeat reagent amounts or steps.

properties.summary: In MeOH-d4:DMSO-d6 (1:1), ligand excitation sensitizes Nd3+. Emission bands are at 880, 1058 and 1530 nm (4F3/2 to 4IJ, J = 9/2, 11/2, 13/2). The 1058 nm lifetime is 3.99 μs at room temperature and 3.70 μs at 77 K. Excitation at 77 K shows both antenna sensitization near 375 nm and direct f–f excitation. No magnetic data are reported for 1 in this paper.

synthesis.procedure: The SI states that [Er2La(LA)2(LB)2(py)(H2O)2](NO3) (2) was prepared according to a previously published procedure; this article does not repeat reagent amounts or steps.

properties.summary: Complex 2 shows the Er3+ 4I13/2 → 4I15/2 emission centered at 1530 nm, with resolved fine structure at 77 K in solution and the solid state. The lifetime is 2.85 μs at room temperature and 3.50 μs at 77 K (monoexponential). Excitation spectra show antenna sensitization and direct excitation of Er3+. No magnetic data are reported for 2 in this paper.

material_class.structural_family: quasi-linear [ErNdEr] heterometallic complex bridged by two LA2- and two LB2-

synthesis.procedure: Main text: one-step reaction of stoichiometric Er(NO3)3, Nd(NO3)3, H2LA and H2LB in pyridine, followed by heptane diffusion; balanced equation uses 2 Er(NO3)3, 1 Nd(NO3)3, 2 H2LA, 2 H2LB, 2 H2O and 9 pyridine, and one equivalent of CuCl2 is added as a crystallization modulator that is not incorporated. SI procedure: a yellow pyridine solution (10 mL) of H2LA (14.8 mg, 0.032 mmol) and H2LB (10.2 mg, 0.032 mmol) was added dropwise to a light-blue pyridine solution (10 mL) of Nd(NO3)3·6H2O (7 mg, 0.016 mmol), Er(NO3)3·5H2O (14.2 mg, 0.032 mmol) and CuCl2·2H2O (2.7 mg, 0.016 mmol). The green solution was stirred for 1 h and layered with hexane. Green [Cu(py)4(NO3)2] crystals formed after one week; large orange crystals of 3 formed after one month and were separated. The SI layering solvent is hexane, whereas the main text says heptane diffusion.
synthesis.time: stirred 1 h; orange crystals after one month
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by solvent layering/diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Layered with hexane (main text: heptane diffusion). Green copper-pyridine nitrate crystals formed after one week; large orange crystals of 3 were separated after one month. The crystal contains one complex and 10 lattice pyridine molecules (11 pyridine total including the coordinated pyridine).

properties.summary: Both Nd3+ (1058 nm) and Er3+ (1530 nm) emit after ligand excitation at 400 nm. Relative to the homometallic analogues, Nd emission intensity falls by about 80% and Er by about 50% in isoabsorbant solutions (OD 0.4 at 400 nm). Lifetimes give Nd-to-Er energy-transfer efficiency ΦET = 0.75 at room temperature and 0.51 at 77 K, and Er-to-Nd back transfer ΦET = 0.33 and 0.34; the back transfer populates a nonemissive Nd state, so there is no net brightness gain. Magnetization data match one Nd3+ and two Er3+: χT is 24.223 cm3 K mol−1 at 295 K (expected 24.60) and 15.991 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, with only very weak antiferromagnetic coupling if any. Magnetization at 5 T is 12.740 μB (2 K) and 12.024 μB (5 K) without saturation.
